additional_units.reported_instrument: segmental multifrequency body composition analyser (TANITA MC 780MA; Tanita Corp., Tokyo, Japan)
additional_units.role_evidence_quote: Muscle mass expressed as the change in SMI (kg/m 2 ) was assessed as the primary outcome between baseline (V1) and end of intervention (V5).
additional_units.result_quote: The aim is to assess the effectiveness of a phenolic rich extra virgin olive oil (EVOO), alone or combined with a prebiotic (PREB) (fructooligosaccharides and inulin), to improve skeletal muscle mass and function in home dwelling older adults (60-80 years) with at least one sarcopenia parameter altered.

additional_units.reported_instrument: segmental multifrequency body composition analyser (TANITA MC 780MA; Tanita Corp., Tokyo, Japan)
additional_units.role_evidence_quote: Other muscle mass parameters were the SM (kg), appendicular skeletal muscle mass (ASM) (kg), appendicular skeletal muscle mass index (ASMI) (kg/m 2 ) as quantity of muscle mass and phase angle ( degrees ) as quality of muscle mass.
additional_units.result_quote: At 12 week follow up, EVOO and EVOO + PREB, compared to ROO, significantly increased skeletal muscle mass and appendicular skeletal muscle mass in all populations assessed by bioelectrical impedance analysis (BIA).

additional_units.reported_instrument: isokinetic dynamometer (Biodex System 4; Biodex Medical Systems, New York, USA)
additional_units.role_evidence_quote: The parameters assessed at an angular velocity of 180 degrees  s -1 and 240 degrees  s -1 in leg extension and flexion were maximum peak torque (Nm), maximum total work (J) and mean power (W) [ 25 ].
additional_units.result_quote: Regarding isokinetic dynamometer parameters at the end of intervention, for total work for extension at 180 degrees  s -1 , a significant increase occurred in all groups. additional_units.role_evidence_quote: The product's adherence was assessed by the bottles of olive oil and the jars of maltodextrin placebo/prebiotic returned at the end of the intervention, considering consumption of > 70% to be an acceptable level of adherence.
additional_units.result_quote: The adherence of the different intervention groups was (1) ROO group (ROO 67.16% and maltodextrin placebo 73.08%), (2) EVOO group (EVOO 79.08% and maltodextrin placebo 70.51%) and (3) EVOO + PREB group (EVOO 72.39% and prebiotic 84.22%), considering a consumption of > 70% to be an acceptable level of product compliance.
